changeLog:
🚀 NEW FEATURES:
- Added comprehensive Re:ANIME source integration featuring dedicated home discovery carousels, instant responsive search, reactive series bookmarks, and an in-app player with VLC-style touch gestures and auto-brightness.
- Implemented high-performance Native Kotlin HLS downloader (Option B) for Re:ANIME with hardware AES-128 decryption and automatic parallel audio track fetching.
- Added Dual-Audio MKV downloader (Option A) with background isolate offloading for zero UI jitter and seamless multi-audio support.
- Added episode batch selection with select-all/deselect-all and multi-episode queuing for Re:ANIME.
- Added interactive source picker to the Re:ANIME home screen header for seamless one-tap switching between sources.
- Overhauled Atlantic provider with Abigail 1080p/4K master streaming, Moscow AES-256-GCM, Athena 4K UHD, and automated Aphrodite Error Code 4 bot-block detection and fallback.

🔧 BUG FIXES:
- Fixed missing audio track in Re:ANIME native downloads by parsing demuxed elementary audio streams, downloading audio segments in parallel, and remuxing into the final MKV container.
- Fixed UI jitter and micro-stutters during Flutter Re:ANIME downloads by offloading pure-Dart AES-128 and XOR de-obfuscation to background isolates (`Isolate.run`) and enforcing a strict 500ms progress throttle.
- Fixed 95px bottom overflow in the Settings default source modal by adding responsive constraints and scrollable category lists.
- Fixed multi-episode download 404 errors by clearing placeholder embed URLs during resolution.
- Fixed large series pagination (100+ episodes, e.g., Naruto, One Piece) via parallelized chunk fetching.
- Fixed subtitle auto-display in external media players (VLC, MX Player) by embedding `-disposition:s:0 default`.
- Fixed shared SQLite database version sync between Flutter (`_dbVersion = 3`) and Kotlin (`DbVersion.CURRENT = 3`).

⚡ IMPROVEMENTS:
- Optimized episode list rendering using a 10-item lazy loading window with downscaled thumbnail memory caching (`160x110`) and repaint boundaries.
- Replaced sequential download stalls with an 8-worker pipelined sliding-window connection pool, accelerating download throughput by up to 6x.
- Added a 15-minute warm cache for headless WASM stream resolution, eliminating 2-4 seconds of WebView startup latency.
